tsin_tr_score_effect = {
 set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score value = 10 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = tsin_tr_draft_partner }
  var:tsin_tr_draft_partner = {
   save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_tr_opinion value = "opinion(prev)" }
  }
  change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = { value = scope:tsin_tr_opinion divide = 10 } }
 }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_alliance = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -40 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_defensive_pact = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -25 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_non_aggression = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -10 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_guarantee = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -20 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_military_access = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -15 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_fleet_basing = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -15 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_food_access = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -8 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_knowledge_share = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -12 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_anti_piracy = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -5 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_mutual_tariff_exempt = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -18 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_tariff_exempt = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -12 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_trade_access = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -10 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_sound_toll_exempt = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -10 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_lift_trade_protection = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -8 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_divert_trade = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = -14 } }
 if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_block_foreign_buildings = 1 } change_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_score add = 5 } }

   remove_variable = tsin_tr_renegotiate_id
  }
  tsin_tr_write_draft_row_effect = yes
  tsin_tr_apply_row_effect = yes
  set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_last_id value = scope:tsin_tr_id }
  tsin_tr_project_page_effect = yes
  tsin_tr_draft_clear_effect = yes
  debug_log = tsin_log_hook_tr_accept
 }

tsin_tr_send_offer_effect = {
 tsin_tr_score_effect = yes
 debug_log = tsin_log_hook_tr_send
 if = { limit = { has_variable = tsin_tr_draft_partner }
  if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_partner = { is_ai = no } }
   var:tsin_tr_draft_partner = {
    set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_incoming_from value = prev }
    set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_incoming_score value = prev.var:tsin_tr_draft_score }
   }
   # Copy draft article flags onto partner for review
   var:tsin_tr_draft_partner = { set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_incoming_alliance value = prev.var:tsin_tr_draft_alliance } }
   var:tsin_tr_draft_partner = { set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_incoming_defensive_pact value = prev.var:tsin_tr_draft_defensive_pact } }

  } else = {
   # AI: accept if score >= 30, reject if <= 0, else coin-flip via score threshold 15
   if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_score >= 30 } tsin_tr_accept_draft_effect = yes }
   else_if = { limit = { var:tsin_tr_draft_score > 0 var:tsin_tr_draft_score >= 15 } tsin_tr_accept_draft_effect = yes }
   else = { tsin_tr_draft_clear_effect = yes }
  }
 }
}

tsin_tr_month_effect = {
 debug_log = tsin_log_hook_tr_month
 set_global_variable = { name = tsin_tr_review_month value = { value = current_year multiply = 12 add = current_month } }
 save_scope_as = tsin_tr_coordinator
 every_in_global_list = { variable = tsin_active_treaties add_to_list = tsin_tr_month_rows }
 every_in_list = { list = tsin_tr_month_rows
  save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_tr_id value = this }
  scope:tsin_tr_coordinator = {
   if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_status|scope:tsin_tr_id)" = 1 }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_tr_party_a_ref value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_party_a|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_tr_party_b_ref value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_party_b|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_tr_bind value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_binding_until|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_tr_now value = { value = current_year multiply = 12 add = current_month } }
    if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_art_monthly_gold|scope:tsin_tr_id)" = 1 "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_gold_month|scope:tsin_tr_id)" > 0 "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_inactive_a|scope:tsin_tr_id)" = 0 "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_inactive_b|scope:tsin_tr_id)" = 0 }
     if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_dir_monthly_gold|scope:tsin_tr_id)" = 1 }
      if = { limit = { scope:tsin_tr_party_a_ref = { gold >= "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_gold_month|scope:tsin_tr_id)" } }
       scope:tsin_tr_party_a_ref = { add_gold = { value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_gold_month|scope:tsin_tr_id)" multiply = -1 } }
       scope:tsin_tr_party_b_ref = { add_gold = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_gold_month|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
       add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_tr_inactive_a key = scope:tsin_tr_id value = 0 }
      } else = {
       add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_tr_inactive_a key = scope:tsin_tr_id value = 1 }
      }
     } else = {
      if = { limit = { scope:tsin_tr_party_b_ref = { gold >= "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_gold_month|scope:tsin_tr_id)" } }
       scope:tsin_tr_party_b_ref = { add_gold = { value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_gold_month|scope:tsin_tr_id)" multiply = -1 } }
       scope:tsin_tr_party_a_ref = { add_gold = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_gold_month|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
       add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_tr_inactive_b key = scope:tsin_tr_id value = 0 }
      } else = {
       add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_tr_inactive_b key = scope:tsin_tr_id value = 1 }
      }
     }
    }
    if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_art_tsin_fx_peg|scope:tsin_tr_id)" = 1 }
     if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_dir_tsin_fx_peg|scope:tsin_tr_id)" = 1 scope:tsin_tr_party_a_ref = { has_variable = tsin_fx } }

      scope:tsin_tr_party_b_ref = { set_variable = { name = tsin_fx value = scope:tsin_tr_fx } }
     }
     if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_dir_tsin_fx_peg|scope:tsin_tr_id)" = 2 scope:tsin_tr_party_b_ref = { has_variable = tsin_fx } }

      scope:tsin_tr_party_a_ref = { set_variable = { name = tsin_fx value = scope:tsin_tr_fx } }
     }
    }
    if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_art_tsin_lend_lease_eq|scope:tsin_tr_id)" = 1 }

   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_tsin_exhibition_pavilion value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_art_tsin_exhibition_pavilion|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_tsin_table_bill value = 0 }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_tsin_lend_lease_eq value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_art_tsin_lend_lease_eq|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_dir_tsin_lend_lease_eq value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_dir_tsin_lend_lease_eq|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_tsin_lend_lease_fuel value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_art_tsin_lend_lease_fuel|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_dir_tsin_lend_lease_fuel value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_dir_tsin_lend_lease_fuel|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_tsin_airbase_rights value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_art_tsin_airbase_rights|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_dir_tsin_airbase_rights value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_dir_tsin_airbase_rights|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_tsin_pollution_compact value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_art_tsin_pollution_compact|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_tsin_labor_migration value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_art_tsin_labor_migration|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_dir_tsin_labor_migration value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_dir_tsin_labor_migration|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }

   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_gold_month value = "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_gold_month|scope:tsin_tr_id)" }
   set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_gold_lump value = 0 }
   tsin_tr_score_effect = yes
  }
 }
}
tsin_tr_open_with_partner_effect = {
 tsin_tr_draft_clear_effect = yes
 set_variable = { name = tsin_tr_draft_partner value = scope:recipient }
 remove_variable = tsin_tr_renegotiate_id
 tsin_tr_score_effect = yes
 tsin_tr_project_page_effect = yes
 debug_log = tsin_log_hook_tr_open_partner
}
tsin_tr_open_effect = {
 tsin_tr_draft_init_effect = yes
 tsin_tr_project_page_effect = yes
}
tsin_tr_succession_effect = {
 save_scope_as = tsin_tr_coordinator
 every_in_global_list = { variable = tsin_active_treaties
  save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = tsin_tr_id value = this }
  scope:tsin_tr_coordinator = {
   if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_party_a|scope:tsin_tr_id)" ?= scope:tsin_annex_target } add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_tr_party_a key = scope:tsin_tr_id value = scope:tsin_annex_recipient } }
   if = { limit = { "global_variable_map(tsin_tr_party_b|scope:tsin_tr_id)" ?= scope:tsin_annex_target } add_to_global_variable_map = { name = tsin_tr_party_b key = scope:tsin_tr_id value = scope:tsin_annex_recipient } }
  }
 }
